body: Unfunded CTA shown while balance loads. hasNoAvailableBalance no longer waits for the live account to finish loading, and isSubmitDisabled dropped the isLoadingAccount guard. getTradeableBalance returns 0 when account is null, so a funded wallet looks unfunded until the stream arrives.
action: Already fixed in 002b882; already replied; thread resolved.

body: Row CTA ignores account loading. The available-to-trade row shows a labeled Add funds control whenever availableBalance is below the unfunded threshold. While the account stream is still loading, getTradeableBalance falls back to 0, so funded users can see the unfunded row CTA.
action: Already fixed in 948c431; already replied; thread resolved.

body: Loading account blocks close and modify. isLoadingAccount now disables submit in every order mode. Close and modify previously waited only for their own validations, so a still-hydrating account stream can block closing or editing a position that is already on screen.
action: Scoped isLoadingAccount submit disable to new-order mode; added close/modify loading tests.
